name: Winter Wonderland
source:
The winter holidays are here but when Alexa finds herself alone after her family is stuck when traveling to Paradise Cove, she is forced to go out and try and find some friends in town to spend the holiday with... But something seems strange.. is the day repeating itself? And if so what does Alexa need to do in order to break the loop and finally enjoy the holiday season.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398730/]Steam[/url]]
